title: Snapchat paid advertising: documented format specifications
scope: Single Image or Video, Story Ads, Collection Ads, Commercials, Sponsored Snaps and cross-format safe zones, with CTA options by attachment. Public official documentation only; not account-tested.

records.format: Single Image or Video (full-screen Snap Ad)
records.placement: Between/after User, Publisher, Creator and Our Stories; Spotlight
records.source_access: Live public browser DOM (JavaScript-rendered Help Center article); no last-updated date shown

copy.brand_name_max: 32 characters with spaces (Help Center); 25 (forbusiness ad formats page)
copy.brand_name_rules: Must reflect paying advertiser; cannot equal headline; required

recommendations.length: 3-5 s (About page, best practices); 'around 5-6 seconds' (best practices)
recommendations.creative: Hero message in opening frame; branding before 0:02 without static logo opener; offer message around 2-3 s; native/UGC style

technical_requirements.length: 3 s to 30 minutes if <=1 GB (Help Center specs); up to 3 minutes (About page); 3-180 s (formats page); <3 s looped to 3 s
technical_requirements.audio: 2 channels (L/R) balanced; target -16 LUFS; PCM or AAC; >=192 kbps; 16 or 24 bit
technical_requirements.other: 13+ audience; Sponsored Creative Tool ads need persistent branding and actionable overlay

safe_zone.classification: Guidance; percentages from diagram, pixels calculated

records.notes: Best-practices page still states top 150 px / bottom 330 px. Additional sources: https://businesshelp.snapchat.com/s/article/image-video-ads?language=en_US ; https://businesshelp.snapchat.com/s/article/snap-ads-practices?language=en_US ; https://forbusiness.snapchat.com/advertising/ad-formats

copy.tile_headline_max: 55 characters with spaces; emojis allowed and counted
copy.headline_behaviour: Create-flow headline applies to all Snaps; 'Use Existing Creative' keeps sub-creative headlines

recommendations.tile_white_background: Add gradient toward bottom behind headline

technical_requirements.tile_logo: 993x284 px PNG transparent; fill full height, or full width and >=50% height
technical_requirements.tile_image: 360x600 px .png up to 2 MB, 8-bit or lower
technical_requirements.tile_buffers: 175 px top; with CTA 175 px top and 269 px bottom; text within 300x128 px
technical_requirements.tile_required: Required for automatic or Discover Feed placement
technical_requirements.snaps: 1-10 Single Image or Video ads meeting SNAP-001
